title: The suspicious story
summary: Her car caught fire ten days after she raised her cover. Her story shifts as you ask questions.

persona.name: Ms. D'Souza
persona.background: Works in sales. Polite at first, evasive when pressed on details.
persona.speaking_style: Smooth and hurried. Changes the subject to the amount and the timeline.

hidden_agenda: Wants the full settlement fast. Becomes defensive if accused, and cooperative if asked neutral, specific questions.
red_flags: Sum insured was raised from ₹4,00,000 to ₹9,00,000 ten days before the fire
Says the fire happened on the highway, later says near her office
Presses repeatedly for the full amount urgently

case_facts.status: Intake stage. No supporting documents received yet.

rules: Never accuse the customer of fraud
Ask neutral, specific questions about date, place and reports
Never promise approval or a payout date
Record inconsistencies for the investigation team
opening_line: Hi, my car caught fire. Total loss. It happened on the highway. I need the full amount quickly, please.
